title: Yolkless German Egg White Omelette in Copper-Mug
description: This earthy and cheese-pull-enhanced omelette is perfect for a morning energizer. It’s low-glycemic-friendly and served in a copper mug, making it both functional and visually appealing.

ingredients.name: optional: 1 tablespoon butter or olive oil for cooking

instructions: Beat the egg whites until frothy, then fold in Parmesan cheese and herbs. Season with salt and pepper.
If using, warm up the mug and a small amount of fat over medium heat to prevent sticking.
Pour the mixture into the mug and cook as you would an omelette on a skillet, allowing it to set slightly before folding gently for about 1 minute.
Slide onto a plate and serve immediately.
